name: Selfee
source:
Hobbies: Cooking
Likes: Shopping
Dream: Becoming a wonderful bride

Selfee lost her parents when she was young and had been raised raised by her grandfather, until he had passed away two years ago. Selfee is now a mercenary under [url=/c124208]Will[/url]'s command, who was her grandfather's subordinate during his military days.
Selfee is strong-willed, but she's otherwise an average girl.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20010212084137/http://www.web-giga.com/seihin/win_pure/p_selfee.htm]official website[/url].]
